lane: EDITORS (documents, spreadsheets, presentations, workspace, photo, video)

features.name: Documents: write and style
features.does: A Word-like page: headings, bold, italic, underline, strike, highlight, lists, checklists you tick, alignment, links, tables, photos, page breaks.
features.note: No comments on words, no text colours; strike and highlight do not work inside table cells.

features.name: Documents: page setup and counts
features.does: Page size, margins, header, footer, page numbers, a live word and page count, autosave said once.

features.name: Documents: find and replace, undo
features.does: Find, replace all, and undo/redo on every change.

features.name: Documents: open any file to read
features.does: Opens PDF, Word, EPUB, web pages, Markdown and text with contents, find, and READ IT TO ME in the phone's voice.

features.name: Documents: Ghosty writes and suggests
features.where: chat, then the reply's laid-out card, or DOCUMENTS → ASK
say: write a letter to my landlord
features.does: Ghosty writes into the page after your paragraph; his edits come as marked suggestions you accept or reject one by one.

features.name: Documents: translate and transliterate
features.does: Paragraph-by-paragraph translation side by side, and letters changed between scripts by tables on the phone.
features.note: Translation uses the brain's words; letters work offline.

features.name: Documents: export and import
features.does: PDF, Word, Markdown and HTML out, and back in with tables, links, pictures, checklists, strike and highlight kept.

features.name: Spreadsheets: grid and formulas
features.does: A real grid with its own formula engine (hundreds of Excel functions), several sheets, named ranges, freeze header, autosave.

features.name: Spreadsheets: rows, columns, AutoSum
features.where: SPREADSHEETS → DATA; Σ on the top bar
features.does: Insert and delete rows and columns with every formula following (or #REF! like Excel), and Σ to total a column in one tap.
features.note: AutoSum over several columns writes into the row below even if it is full (undo restores it).

features.name: Spreadsheets: format, sort, filter, fill, chart
features.does: Money and percent formats, fills, sort and filter by a column, fill down and right, a chart from a range.

features.name: Spreadsheets: Ghosty in the sheet
say: write a formula for the total
features.does: Explains a cell, writes a formula, and suggests a column tidy-up you accept or reject one change at a time.

features.name: Spreadsheets: files
features.does: Excel, CSV and PDF out; Excel and CSV in, formulas kept and what could not be kept said; a 10,000-row file opens in under a second.

features.name: Presentations: decks and themes
say: make slides from my last answer
features.does: Slides with layouts, themes that repaint every slide, pictures, charts, tables, shapes, notes; reorder by drag, duplicate, delete, undo.

features.name: Presentations: present
features.does: Full-screen talk with builds, fade and push transitions, arrows and swipes, skipped slides stepped over, reduced motion respected.

features.name: Presentations: find and replace across the deck
features.does: Searches titles, text, tables and notes on every slide, jumps to each, replaces all.
features.note: Replace does not keep capital letters; a word split across bold and plain is not found.

features.name: Presentations: files
features.does: PowerPoint, PDF and pictures out; PowerPoint in, transitions and skipped slides kept, what is lost said.
features.note: Animations (builds) are not carried in PowerPoint files.

features.name: Workspace: pages and blocks
features.does: Notion-like pages inside pages, headings, lists, to-dos, callouts (note, tip, warning), links, backlinks, comments, '/' to add a block.
features.note: No toggles (fold-away blocks) or highlighter key yet.

features.name: Workspace: databases
say: what is due this week in my project
features.does: Tables shown as a board, calendar, timeline, gallery or table, with filters, formulas, relations and rollups.

features.name: Workspace: history, bin, search, ask
features.where: WORKSPACE → HISTORY / BIN / SEARCH / ASK ABOUT THIS PROJECT
features.does: Versions with restore, a bin, search across pages, Ghosty answering about the project with its size said.

features.name: Workspace: export and import
say: import a csv as a database
features.does: A zip of Markdown and CSV out, and back in with callouts, strike and links kept.

features.name: Photo: light, colour, curves, detail, effects
features.does: Lightroom-style sliders and curves, drawn on the phone's graphics chip with tiles for big photos; hold to see the original.

features.name: Photo: crop, masks, heal, layers
features.does: Crop with ratios and straighten, gradient, brush and subject masks, heal blemishes, a second picture as a layer.

features.name: Photo: looks, copy and paste edits, batch
say: put my golden hour look on this
features.does: Built-in and saved looks, copy one photo's edits onto another, and a batch export of many photos with the total size said.

features.name: Photo: RAW, cut-out and erase
features.where: PHOTO → open a RAW, or SUBJECT / ERASE
features.does: RAW photos, a subject cut-out, and erasing things, each using a free model downloaded only on your tap with its size said; EXPORT ORIGINAL gives the RAW back exactly.

features.name: Photo: export
features.does: JPEG, PNG or the untouched original, size said before saving; location stripped from edited files.
features.note: The brain's own photo edits still come through the Lens's PHOTO TOOLS, not as marked changes inside the editor.

features.name: Video: timeline and clips
features.does: A CapCut-style timeline: add, trim, split, move, duplicate and delete clips, speed and ramps, with undo and redo.

features.name: Video: transitions and fades
features.does: Crossfade, dip to black, wipe and slide between clips; fade in and out from black, sound included.
features.note: Fade length is fixed, no slider yet.

features.name: Video: grade, LUT, chroma key, masks, overlay
features.does: Colour grade copied to every clip, LUTs, a green-screen key, rectangle and ellipse masks, pictures over the video.

features.name: Video: titles, subtitles, music
features.does: Titles at the playhead, subtitles typed or from a recording, music with fades and cuts on the beat.

features.name: Video: smart helpers
say: find the cuts in this clip
features.does: Finds scene cuts, finds and removes pauses, and picks the best clips, all on the phone.

features.name: Video: export
features.does: Exports an MP4 with the size said before, saved when you hide the app.
features.note: In the test container the exported length was about 0.1 s off the timeline; the CI TIMING lane owns that. Steadying is also that lane's.

upward.idea: Comments and replies on words in Documents, with Ghosty able to answer a comment
upward.why: Real review like Word and Pages, and a way to ask about one sentence
upward.builds_on: the workspace's block comments and the documents' suggestions

upward.idea: Colour-by-rule in Spreadsheets (overdue in red, top 10 in green, data bars)
upward.why: See problems at a glance, the way Excel and Numbers do
upward.builds_on: the formula engine and the format panel

upward.idea: Pivot tables and a one-tap summary of any table
upward.why: Answer 'how much per month or per shop' without writing formulas
upward.builds_on: the formula engine, sort and filter, and charts

upward.idea: Animated builds carried in and out of PowerPoint, plus Magic Move between slides
upward.why: Keynote-level talks that still open in PowerPoint
upward.builds_on: the PowerPoint reader and writer, and the talk's builds

upward.idea: Presenter view: next slide, notes and a timer on the phone while the slide shows on a TV
upward.why: Give a talk from the phone with confidence
upward.builds_on: the talk mode and slide notes

upward.idea: Toggles, synced blocks and page templates in the Workspace
Ghosty's photo edits as marked changes inside the Photo editor ('a warmer look, +0.3 exposure': accept or reject each)
upward.why: Same trust model as documents, and no hop to the Lens
upward.builds_on: the photo recipe and the brain's photo tools

upward.idea: Local adjustments by brush in Video (brighten a face only)
upward.builds_on: video masks and the photo brush mask

upward.idea: Adjustable fade lengths and keyframes on any slider in Video
upward.why: Smooth zooms, fades and colour changes over time, like CapCut
upward.builds_on: video keys at the playhead and fades

upward.idea: Version compare: see two versions side by side with changes coloured, in every editor
upward.why: Know exactly what changed and restore just one part
upward.builds_on: the workspace history and the documents' word-by-word compare

upward.idea: Faster first open after boot so every editor opens in under a second
upward.why: The spreadsheet itself opens in under 30 ms, but the work after boot holds the MAKE page for 1–3 s
upward.builds_on: the app's start-up work (with the boot and home lanes)

upward.idea: Spelling and grammar checked on the phone in Documents and Slides, with suggestions he accepts
upward.why: Clean writing without sending words anywhere
upward.builds_on: the suggestion system and a free on-phone word list downloaded on his tap, on Wi-Fi, with the size said

upward.idea: Outline view in Documents: jump to any heading, move a whole section
upward.why: Handle long documents like Word's navigation pane

upward.idea: Photo: noise reduction and sharper enlargements using a free model, downloaded on his tap
upward.builds_on: the photo packs (cut-out, erase) and their download rules

sideways.idea: Forms: make a form in the Workspace, fill it on the phone, answers land in a database
sideways.why: Sign-up sheets, checklists and surveys of his own

sideways.idea: Mail merge: one letter, many names from a spreadsheet
sideways.why: Invitations and letters in one go

sideways.idea: Scan a paper document straight into an editable Document, or a receipt into a Spreadsheet row
sideways.why: Paper to editable in one tap
sideways.builds_on: the scan's page reader and text reading, documents and sheets

sideways.idea: Collage and layout maker for photos
Slideshow video from photos with music on the beat
sideways.why: A memory film in one tap
sideways.builds_on: video's beat cuts and the photo shelf

sideways.idea: Voice notes to tidy notes: record, get a transcript, Ghosty turns it into a Document or Workspace page
sideways.why: Think out loud, get a clean page
sideways.builds_on: video subtitles from a recording, and documents

sideways.idea: Teleprompter for video, reading from a Document
sideways.why: Record a clean piece to camera

sideways.idea: Diagram and mind-map page in the Workspace
sideways.why: Plan visually, then turn branches into to-dos

sideways.idea: Budget dashboard: charts from his spreadsheets pinned as a page
Audio editor: trim, fade and clean up a recording
sideways.why: Podcasts and voice memos, without a separate app
sideways.builds_on: video's sound mix, pause finder and fades

sideways.idea: Screen recording to a tutorial video with titles
sideways.why: Show someone how to do something

sideways.builds_on: the documents' PDF reader and writer
